question: Can a recurrent four-layer suffix trained on observed-value rationales and independent multi-argument demonstrations beat Base on fresh executable tasks including comparisons?
gate: Require at least 12 net successes per 50 questions, exact paired p <= .05, no slower than Base, at least 6/10 two-value comparisons and 7/10 dependent chains. Stop on resource limit or memory warning. Failure closes release and matched-depth claims for this fit. Fit once from untouched Base, no teacher model. Fresh domains and mixed independent wording. If positive independently test larger-schema and counterfactual transfer.
